name: Origami crane
notes: Origin at body centre, beak +Z, up +Y. Joints flap -1...1 (wings 50 deg), fold 0...1 (flat square, diagonal triangle, bird base, finished crane; finished parts appear at 0.7), neck -1...1 (25 deg pitch). Flat folded facets by design. Washi tint via the washi material hex.
parts: diamond body with lapped side creases
two swept wings with leading-edge crease and folded-over layer
V-folded neck with head and beak
staged fold shells: flat sheet, diagonal triangle, bird base
style: Crisp flat paper folds, washi paper PBR with fibre normal, roughness 0.8 and translucency, pale reverse side, original shapes only.
summary: 0.6 m wingspan origami crane of washi paper with crisp folded facets and joints flap, fold, neck; fold 0 is a flat square sheet.
